Title: Architecture review gate B
Purpose: Stop after runtime singularity and workspace quiescence work to verify that the runtime now has both DB-backed singularity and deterministic UI action ordering before query/cohesion work begins.
Deliverables: A written Gate B memo with an explicit pass/fail decision.
An explicit statement on whether runtime singularity and workspace action ordering are now materially safe.
A corrective subbundle if either runtime uniqueness or workspace quiescence still leaks through assumptions.
ValidationCommands: Review the live repository, migrations, and fresh tests for subbundles 04-05.
ReviewQuestions: Does the database now protect runtime singularity strongly enough to match the service code’s assumptions?
Can the workspace still publish, delete, or export against stale or racing definition state?
Do the new tests prove both the DB uniqueness side and the UI quiescence side?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any answer is no, stop and open the runtime-uniqueness or workspace-quiescence corrective playbook before continuing.
